ai.seo_question: What does it mean to uphold one's testimonies in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Ma'arij is often linked to the concept of 'Amanah' (trustworthiness), emphasizing that true believers maintain their testimonies not only in legal contexts but as a comprehensive moral duty. Scholars highlight this steadfastness as a distinguishing trait of the righteous who uphold justice and integrity even when it is difficult, reflecting the broader Quranic theme of fulfilling covenants.
